verification status: Confirmed. Primary-source check, October 8, 2026: the comments' account of the 75/75 test, its proposed retirement and the 6 percent cap matches the proposed rule.
verification note: Source: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-07-23/pdf/2026-14897.pdf. Page: proposed § 433.68(f)(3)(ii)(A)(3), 91 FR 46598 (preamble 46572). Wording: “In no case shall the threshold percentage exceed 6 percent unless, as of July 4, 2025, the State’s tax met the requirements”. The 75/75 test: a tax above the threshold is a hold harmless if, in the aggregate, 75 percent of taxpayers get back 75 percent or more of their tax (91 FR 46564). CMS proposes to stop applying the test for FFYs beginning on or after October 1, 2026 (91 FR 46581; summary at 46562). It keeps the 75/75 test only as the exception to the 6 percent cap and does not expect any state to meet it (46572). What this changes in v16: qualifies. 'At most 6.0%' is CMS's proposed cap, with an exception CMS expects no state to use, and its cite is 91 FR 46572 and 46598, not 46562. 'Most taxed providers also get most of their tax back' stands for the 75/75 test, measured in the aggregate.

verification note: Source: P.L. 119-21, sec. 71115(a)(2), https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/PLAW-119publ21/html/PLAW-119publ21.htm. Page: 139 Stat. 302. Wording: “shall apply for a fiscal year instead of the applicable percent specified in clause (ii) for the fiscal year”. Clause (iv) covers expansion-state taxes in effect, and within the threshold, at enactment on the classes in 42 CFR 433.56(a)(3), nursing facility services, and (a)(4), ICF/IID services (CFR 2025 edition, https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CFR-2025-title42-vol4/pdf/CFR-2025-title42-vol4-sec433-56.pdf). CMS describes the exemption as statutory (91 FR 46565, 46576) and says those classes stay held to the July 4, 2025 threshold. The comments that call it CMS's proposal (NRHA, AMGA) misattribute it. What this changes in v16: nothing. The exemption belongs in the 'Required by the OBBBA' column. It exempts these taxes from the phase-down only, and 'intermediate care facility' means ICF/IID.
